Name: Maono Mic Mute
Description: Mute and unmute a Maono USB microphone with a key press. The key shows whether the microphone is muted.

Actions.Name: Toggle Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Mute or unmute the Maono microphone; the key shows whether it is muted

Localization.Automatic mutes the Maono microphone con: Automatic mutes the Maono microphone connected over USB, ahead of virtual devices such as Maono AI Microphone.
Localization.The key turns red while the microphone i: The key turns red while the microphone is muted, also when another app mutes it.
Localization.No Maono microphone that can be muted is: No Maono microphone that can be muted is connected.
Localization.The selected microphone is not connected: The selected microphone is not connected.
Localization.This microphone cannot be muted from the: This microphone cannot be muted from the computer.
Localization.Could not change the mute of the microph: Could not change the mute of the microphone.
